reviews.comment: Harsh indeed! Understand that Dr. Taliaferro's lectures are not very engaging as he speaks in a monotone voice. His exam/quiz questions can come from anywhere in the homework, so if you're struggling on one topic you can harm your grade. I worked way too hard in this class. If this course is not required, just avoid it. It's not worth the money.
Awful handwriting that can't recognize. Class progress is too fast.

I got a perfect score in the class and had a very easy time in the class but from what I noticed around me, my classmates were constantly confused and did poorly on the tests. Do all the hw or you will fail. He isn't that accessible so make friends in class and rely on them to help you. Overall, he is a very average teacher teaching a hard subject.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The worst professor Ive had at A&M. Grades overly hard to the point where you dont even want to try anymore. One mistake on a quiz and youll be getting a 50. Taliaferro does not care about his students at all and puts bare minimum effort into being a professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Awful prof. Writes in cursive so its impossible to read and speaks softly into the board so you cant hear him either. Doesnt give reviews for exams and grades way too hard. Take literally anyone else

He copied notes from a piece of paper and didn't post them online, but they were organized in a way that was consistent and made sense. His exams were like in-class examples, quizzes, and homework, and he had reviews that would specify what topics the exam would cover. You have to try to get an A in this class, but it's not impossible.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He just copies his notes onto the board & is very old, sometimes couldn't hear or didn't understand questions that were asked. He has a one question quiz every week so you need to know how to do all of the problems. Homework isn't required but important to do if you want to pass, it's a lot. Usually 5 questions on the 3 exams so you can't miss much
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: There is very little room for error with this professor. You will almost certainly lose most credit for a question because of a small error. There are weekly quizzes that count as 25% of your grade. Make one mistake? You're lucky to make a 50. Same grading goes for exams too. Exams are 5 questions so each mistake is basically a letter grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: There is little room for error if you want to get an A. Yes he is challenging but this course itself was relatively easy if you keep up with the homework. His lectures are very clear. I finally understand how calc 1,2,&3 come together which was a rewarding feeling. There is a quiz every week and he tells you what homework problems you need to do.

He writes his class notes on th board from a bundle of papers each class. He answers questions well and obviously enjoys the material. The homework is optional but essentially necessary to pass. The tests are about half proofs (since it was an honors course I believe) but it didnt seem to be as hard as the regular sections. Sympathetic grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His course is not very difficult, but he has a quiz for every week. He assigns too much homeworks, though he doesn't ask us to hand in, he puts them in the quiz. The midterm and final exam are easy.

Extremely time-demanding if you want to get an A (this is even true for a B I guess). A lot of homework is assigned every week and you must do it in order to be prepared for the weekly quizz. Don't miss any class. a lot of material is covered per lecture. You'll have to work hard but at the end you'll feel you've learned something.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You are bombarded with quizzes from a large array of homework assignments in which you barely have time to get done. Did I mention that the homework isn't for a grade? There is no room for error in his class. If you make one mistake then you're grade is shot. He will fly through his lecture and you can't really ask questions. He uses Maple.

Made A's in all my math classes, and this is the first class I've ever dropped.  About 50 HW questions a week, and the quizzes are on homework and lecture.  The weekly quiz is over the homework(few lecture examples) or the lecture (doesn't help with HW). At first students gasped when he assigns HW, but then doing 30 HW problems in 2 days is normal.
